description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Engineering Mechanics topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: engg-mechanics

facts.claim: Lami's theorem: three coplanar concurrent forces in equilibrium, each ∝ sine of the opposite angle

source.quote: relating the magnitudes of three coplanar, concurrent and non-collinear force vectors, which keeps an object in static equilibrium

facts.claim: Uses the angles directly opposite each force

source.quote: with the angles directly opposite to the corresponding vectors

facts.claim: A couple: two equal, opposite, non-collinear forces

source.quote: a couple is a pair of forces that are equal in magnitude but opposite in their direction of action

facts.claim: Moment of a couple = F × d (N·m)

source.quote: The magnitude of the torque is equal to F • d

facts.claim: An FBD shows all forces, moments and reactions acting on an isolated body

source.quote: It depicts a body or connected bodies with all the applied forces and moments, and reactions, which act on the body(ies)

facts.claim: Static friction (at rest) and kinetic friction (moving)

source.quote: Dry friction is subdivided into static friction ("stiction") between non-moving surfaces, and kinetic friction between moving surfaces

facts.claim: Friction is proportional to the normal force (F = μN)

source.quote: the macroscopic proportionality between normal force and static frictional force between dry surfaces

facts.claim: Truss members are two-force members joined at pins (joints)

source.quote: a truss is a structure that "consists of two-force members only

facts.claim: Members carry only tension or compression

source.quote: result in forces in the members that are either tensile or compressive

facts.claim: The centroid is the mean position of all points (geometric centre)

source.quote: the centroid, also known as geometric center or center of figure, of a plane figure or solid figure is the mean position of all the points in the figure

facts.claim: A triangle's centroid is where the medians meet

source.quote: The centroid of a triangle is the intersection of the three medians of the triangle

facts.claim: I = I_cm + m d² about a parallel axis at distance d

source.quote: which is parallel to the first axis and displaced from it by a distance d

facts.claim: d is the perpendicular distance between the two parallel axes

source.quote: d is the perpendicular distance between the axes z and z

facts.claim: Second moment of area measures a beam's resistance to bending

source.quote: provides insight into a beam's resistance to bending due to an applied moment

facts.claim: Depends on how the area is distributed about an axis

source.quote: a geometrical property of an area which reflects how its points are distributed with regard to an arbitrary axis

facts.claim: Add an inertia force (−ma) to get dynamic equilibrium

source.quote: introducing forces of inertia which, when added to the applied forces in a system, result in dynamic equilibrium

facts.claim: Without air resistance the path is a parabola

source.quote: the object follows a parabolic path determined by its initial velocity and the constant acceleration due to gravity

facts.claim: Depends on launch speed, launch angle and g

source.quote: neglect nearly every factor except for initial velocity, the launch angle and a gravitational acceleration assumed constant

facts.claim: e = relative speed of separation / relative speed of approach

source.quote: the relative speed of separation of two surfaces immediately after a collision is directly proportional to the relative speed of approach

facts.claim: e = 1 perfectly elastic, e = 0 perfectly inelastic

source.quote: 1 represents a perfectly elastic collision

facts.claim: In equilibrium the total virtual work of the applied forces is zero

source.quote: the principle of least action requires the virtual work of these forces to be zero

facts.claim: Uses imagined (virtual) displacements

source.quote: The work of a force on a particle along a virtual displacement is known as the virtual work

facts.claim: The instantaneous centre is the point with zero velocity at that instant

source.quote: a point that has zero velocity at a particular instant of time

facts.claim: For a rolling wheel it is the contact point

source.quote: The point of contact P of the wheel with road does not slip
